posts.body_html:
Some updated pics! First two photos were taken by Luca Leeser (he grew them outdoors in NY). Compare the looks to the exact same clone grown outdoors in Northern California, this shows this particular phenotype is relatively stable. Without a doubt, while these look jaw dropping impressive, this plant is still no way at its fullest potential!
